title: ST7Q: ST7-FD only while QQQ is at/below its VWAP (RSI Collapse Dip Buy, Nasdaq-below-VWAP only, all day)
hypothesis: ST7 is a dip buy: it works when the stock's drop is part of a market dip (QQQ below VWAP) and fails when the stock falls alone into a strong market.
live_support: live paper 16 trades: QQQ<=VWAP 5 trades +0.90R avg (+4.5R) vs QQQ>VWAP 11 trades -0.10R (-1.1R); all 5 of the 10-21 losers were QQQ>VWAP
notes: 2y: train n183 +0.092 / valid n351 +0.141, t 2.27 (lineage bar 4.97 not met), excess vs random +0.062/+0.189, top day 14.6%. Bull +0.654 / Bear +0.059 / Choppy +0.188 / Quiet +0.091 (parent +0.226/-0.177/+0.126/+0.021). Total 2y +66.4R vs parent +24.4R on half the trades; up-day total R 27.8 vs 54.9 (gives up up-day R). Chosen AFTER the diagnosis (post-hoc). Needs a qqq_vwap live context column (fail-safe without it). Meets owner near-miss merit rule. Educational only - not financial advice.

title: ST7-FD: let winners run on up days (1.5R/2R targets, hold, trail, scale-out, SPY-above-VWAP conditional exits)
hypothesis: Wider targets / holding add profit on up days.
notes: Holding raises Bull-day avg (+0.356 hold vs +0.226) but Bear days get worse (-0.435) and train AND valid fall (hold -0.097/-0.021; 2R -0.100/-0.001). Conditional F2 (2R only when SPY>VWAP at entry) ~= parent (-0.070/+0.072). No exit passes. Educational only - not financial advice.

title: ST7-FD only in a strong tape (SPY/QQQ above VWAP, SPY up from open, breadth rising, RS vs SPY)
hypothesis: An 'up-day' version should only buy while the market is strong.
live_support: 10-21: all 5 losers were bought with SPY/QQQ above VWAP
notes: Backwards: SPY>VWAP -0.091/-0.022, QQQ>VWAP -0.211/-0.011, SPY up from open +0.057/-0.011; Bear days -0.78..-1.22. Buying a stock falling alone into a strong market is the losing half of ST7. Educational only - not financial advice.
